mapper.select:
/* QueryID=kkdugi.core.menu.mapper.MenuBaseMapper.findAll */ SELECT
FROM kkdugi_menu_base ORDER BY menu_lvl, sort_seq NULLS LAST, menu_id

/* QueryID=kkdugi.core.menu.mapper.MenuBaseMapper.findSelfAndDescendants */ SELECT
FROM kkdugi_menu_base WHERE menu_path = #{path} OR menu_path LIKE #{path} || '/%'
mapper.insert: /* QueryID=kkdugi.core.menu.mapper.MenuBaseMapper.insert */ INSERT INTO kkdugi_menu_base (menu_id, menu_parent_id, menu_ico, menu_pgm, menu_lvl, menu_path, sort_seq, use_yn, close_yn, reg_dtm, reg_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{icon}, #{program}, #{level}, #{path}, #{sort}, #{use}, #{close}, #{createdAt}, #{creatorId})
